NEURO-SCAN-01.purpose: Maps aggregation cascade pathways. Identifies seeding nodes, propagation routes, bottlenecks.
NEURO-SCAN-01.formula: NEURO_01, NEURO_02, T12. aggregation + synaptic + propagation

NEURO-SCAN-02.purpose: Scores glial-neuronal circuit activation state; tracked across dataset additions.

NEURO-SCAN-03.purpose: Evaluates blood-brain barrier penetrance probability for therapeutic agents vs. property thresholds.

NEURO-SCAN-04.purpose: Correlates mechanism biomarkers with cognitive decline trajectory over time.
NEURO-SCAN-04.formula: NEURO_05, S03, TEMP_02. Lag-adjusted correlation + temporal

CARDIO-SCAN-01.purpose: Maps metabolic flux dysregulation; identifies rate-limiting nodes.

GENE-SCAN-01.purpose: Scores viral vector serotypes for on-target efficiency and tissue tropism.

GENE-SCAN-02.purpose: Tracks CAR-T exhaustion score and persistence markers over timepoints.

RARE-SCAN-01.purpose: Maps variant pathogenicity across a rare disease gene network (ClinVar, gnomAD, SRL evidence).

RARE-SCAN-02.purpose: Tracks natural history biomarker trajectories across disease progression timepoints.
RARE-SCAN-02.formula: RARE_02, RARE_04, R10. progression + validated endpoints

INF-D-SCAN-01.purpose: Scores host network vulnerability nodes targeted by pathogen effectors. Identifies bottleneck host nodes.
INF-D-SCAN-01.formula: INF_02, INF_03, T11. vulnerability + bottleneck intervention targets

INF-D-SCAN-02.purpose: Tracks resistance/immune escape mutation trajectory over variant generations. Cross-institution data maximizes value.

AGE-SCAN-01.purpose: Scores senescent cell burden vs. clearance efficiency trajectory across tissue contexts.
AGE-SCAN-01.formula: AGE_01, AGE_03, T13. net = burden×(1−clearance); potential = clearance×(1−perturbation)

AG-SCAN-01.purpose: Scores CRISPR editing target feasibility: on-target efficiency, guide accessibility, essential gene risk.
AG-SCAN-01.formula: EDIT_01, EDIT_03, EDIT_04. feasibility = on_target × accessibility × chromatin

AG-SCAN-02.purpose: Maps CRISPR off-target editing risk across the genome network.
AG-SCAN-02.formula: EDIT_02, T12, T13. impact = cutting × propagation × perturbation

AG-SCAN-03.purpose: Scores crop water-use efficiency trait mechanisms across environmental conditions. Pairs with SCAN-16.

AG-SCAN-04.purpose: Maps epigenetic marks (methylation, histone mods) and regulatory effects on crop traits.

AG-SCAN-05.purpose: Tracks durability of pathogen resistance gene effectiveness across breeding generations.

AG-SCAN-06.purpose: Maps microbiome composition interactions with crop trait outcomes across environments.

AG-SCAN-07.purpose: Dissects yield into component traits, maps each to QTL and pathway evidence.
AG-SCAN-07.formula: R19, G04, N05. Polygenic + FDR per component

AG-SCAN-08.purpose: Scores selection gain per generation; tracks breeding cycle efficiency and projected gain.
AG-SCAN-08.formula: BREED_01, BREED_02, BREED_06. GEBV × (ΔG/interval); projected gains

AG-SCAN-09.purpose: Identifies pleiotropic consequences of selecting for hypothesis-associated traits.
AG-SCAN-09.formula: R19, T12, T13, CLIN_03. net = primary − 0.3×Σ pleiotropy Flags: >0.5× HIGH, >0.2× MODERATE, else ACCEPTABLE

SRL-SCAN-01.purpose: Confirms SRL-stored assertions are supported by traceable literature sources. Confirmation rate.
SRL-SCAN-01.formula: I04, I05, E02, E15. triple → validate → confidence + provenance

SRL-SCAN-02.purpose: Confirms Subject/Object/Predicate triple structure of SRL assertions against source text.
SRL-SCAN-02.formula: I05, E02, E14. Direct lookup → match + evidence count

INF-SCAN-01.purpose: Detects drift in evidence support over time — established edges becoming stale as newer contradictory/null evidence accumulates.
INF-SCAN-01.formula: TEMP_01, TEMP_02, E18. Windows → trend → drift detection. Also: Novelty Decay

INF-SCAN-02.purpose: Resolves semantic contradictions between SRL assertions using provenance, study-type hierarchy, methodological quality. Agent required.
INF-SCAN-02.formula: SEM_03, E06, E15. Resolution → winning direction + confidence

INF-SCAN-03.purpose: Detects centrality ranking changes between graph versions from new dataset ingestion.
INF-SCAN-03.formula: N05, V07, TEMP_01. Per window: centrality snapshot → gainers/losers

INF-SCAN-04.purpose: Classifies user hypothesis intent to route scan weighting and UI framing. Metadata only, not primary display.
INF-SCAN-04.formula: V01, V05, P01, J3. Query → intent → scan pipeline recommendation

NET-SCAN-01.purpose: Detects when ≥2 independent institutions validate the same mechanism edge. Triggers Common Knowledge Threshold transition.
NET-SCAN-01.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-02.purpose: Detects multiple users approaching the same white space from different directions. Competitive timing intelligence.
NET-SCAN-02.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-03.purpose: Validates biomarkers independently across different user population cohorts.
NET-SCAN-03.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-04.purpose: Detects when a mechanism is studied in fragments across institutions with no single user seeing the full picture.
NET-SCAN-04.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-05.purpose: Surfaces genuine cross-user contradiction on the same edge with independent dataset candidates for arbitration.
NET-SCAN-05.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-06.purpose: Aggregates rare variant signals across institutions individually too infrequent to detect alone.
NET-SCAN-06.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

NET-SCAN-07.purpose: Aggregates off-target/adverse event signals across institutions individually too rare to flag alone.
NET-SCAN-07.formula: NOT SPECIFIED IN SOURCE DOCUMENT -- proposed formula pending team definition. Use analogous scans in this family as a starting point.

SCAN-01.purpose: Consolidates all edge-level evidence across ingested datasets into a ranked FinalScore per entity pair. Weighted aggregation of statistical association, effect size, cross-replication, and network integration. Universal baseline -- auto-runs post-ingestion. Also maps the aggregate score to an explicit Edge Quality Tier, decoupled from source-type provenance.
SCAN-01.formula: score(e) = E04(w1xSA + w2xES + w3xrecency + w4xreplication); edge_quality_tier = TIER_MAP(compute_edge_aggregate_score)

SCAN-02.purpose: Computes betweenness, degree, and eigenvector centrality for all nodes. Classifies each node into one of four network-role archetypes via the betweenness x eigenvector matrix, in addition to the raw influence_score.
SCAN-02.formula: influence(n) = N05(w_deg×N01 + w_bet×N02 + w_eig×N03); network_role = ROLE_MATRIX(N02_tier, N03_tier)
SCAN-02.weight_profile: w_deg=0.30, w_bet=0.40, w_eig=0.30 (corrected -- source doc listed 4 weights against a 3-term formula; PRIM_N05 default weight profile corrected to match, see 00_Primitive_Library changelog)

SCAN-03.purpose: Evaluates cross-study directional concordance per edge AND outputs the net aggregate direction itself (up-regulates / down-regulates / bidirectional / un-directed), not just whether studies agree.
SCAN-03.formula: Mode concordance: aggregate_direction = sign(mean(effect_directions)); flag CONCORDANT/MIXED/CONFLICTED per edge. Mode conflict: severity = E06(e) x E14(e) for edges with concordance < 0.50

SCAN-04.purpose: DEPRECATED. This scan's entire formula (log-scaled saturation of PRIM_N06) is a strict subset of SCAN-06 (Evidence Maturity), which already computes saturation plus replication, cross-modality concordance, and recency. Kept as a stub to avoid breaking any stored references to scan_id 'SCAN-04'; the orchestration layer should route execution requests for SCAN-04 to SCAN-06 and copy the node_support
SCAN-04.formula: STUB -- see SCAN-06. Original: saturation = log(1 + 5×raw) / log(6), scaled by domain_scaling_factor (see 00_Domain_Scaling_Table).

SCAN-05.purpose: Detects two-hop gaps (missing bridge nodes) between hypothesis nodes and scores each candidate bridge.
SCAN-05.formula: gaps = T06(activated_node_pair_set); bridge_score(bridge) = R07(bridge, src, tgt) = Betweenness(bridge) x ES(A→B) x ES(B→C) x (1 - ES(A→C))

SCAN-06.purpose: Evaluates the lifecycle stage of edge evidence: saturation, replication, cross-modality concordance, AND temporal recency/staleness, domain-scaled via PRIM_H05.biological_domain. Absorbs and supersedes deprecated SCAN-04.
SCAN-06.formula: edge_support_saturation = log(1 + 5xraw/domain_scaling_factor) / log(6); domain_scaling_factor = DOMAIN_SCALING_TABLE[PRIM_H05.biological_domain].saturation_multiplier; evidence_recency_score = E19(edge) [NEW PRIMITIVE -- see 00_Primitive_Library changelog]

SCAN-07.purpose: Extracts the minimal DAG (Steiner tree) connecting exposure and outcome nodes with highest evidential support, and classifies its topology.
SCAN-07.formula: minimal_spanning_subgraph_edges = T05(hypothesis_nodes); aggregate_path_score = R15(path); bridge_score = R07(e) per edge; topology_descriptor = TOPOLOGY_CLASSIFY(branch_count)

SCAN-08.purpose: Stratifies edge evidence by tissue, cell type, disease stage, treatment, genotype. Identifies context-universal vs. context-specific edges via an explicit context_universality_score.

SCAN-09.scope: Edge (perturbation/GxE) and Hypothesis (mechanism confidence, decomposed separately per Master Law 1)
SCAN-09.purpose: Validates causal ordering via Mendelian Randomization / GxE logic, temporal precedence, and structural consistency, distinguishing correlation from proven causation. Edge-level and hypothesis-level outputs are now split since PRIM_R06 is explicitly hypothesis-level per its own spec.
SCAN-09.formula: Mode path_scoring: aggregate_path_score = PathScore x concordance. Mode consistency: mean concordance across all paths. Mode MR: R20(exposure, outcome, instruments). Mode mechanism: R06(hypothesis) [hypothesis-scope only]

SCAN-10.purpose: Computes agreement between evidence from different modalities (transcriptomics, proteomics, CRISPR, in-vitro vs in-vivo, etc.) and outputs the aggregated translational concordance score.

SCAN-11.purpose: Reads (read-only) the full provenance chain for all hypothesis-supporting assertions on an edge, for regulatory submission and reproducibility. Does NOT write the audit log itself (Master Law 4).
SCAN-11.formula: provenance_chain = E15(e) per assertion; contradiction_flags = I06(e); traceability_status = TRACE_CLASSIFY(provenance_chain)

SCAN-12.purpose: Maps mechanism edges across species via ortholog databases and computes a homology conservation score.
SCAN-12.formula: identified_orthologs = T15(edge, species); homology_conservation_score = R22(edge, species) = orth_conf(src) x orth_conf(tgt) x ES(ortholog_edge)

SCAN-13.purpose: Aggregates polygenic variant signals across a pathway into a composite, FDR-corrected, domain-scaled score. Detects non-additive interactions.
SCAN-13.formula: polygenic_mechanism_score = Sum(effect_weight x PathScore(variant->pathway) x ES(variant->gene)), FDR corrected (BH, alpha=0.05); domain_scaling_factor = DOMAIN_SCALING_TABLE[PRIM_H05.biological_domain]

SCAN-14.purpose: Computes network proximity/co-localization of hypothesis nodes to a target subgraph, with a statistical significance test on the overlap.
SCAN-14.formula: colocalization_score = R18(a,b,scope) = (observed/expected) x mean(ES_edges); hypergeometric_p_value = S20_HYPERGEOM(shared_neighborhood, graph_size) [NEW PRIMITIVE]

SCAN-15.purpose: Maps GWAS trait associations to mechanism nodes, explicitly naming the associated trait. Agent interpretation required for causal inference.

SCAN-16.purpose: Models genotype-by-environment interactions and stratifies effect size by environment x genotype, surfacing the actual regression statistics.
SCAN-16.formula: Y = b0+b1G+b2E+b3(GxE)+e; gxe_regression = {beta_interaction=b3, SE, t_stat=b3/SE, fdr_p}

SCAN-17.purpose: Ranks nodes by predictive power as biomarkers using ROC-equivalent graph-proximal features and true node-level cohort separation.
SCAN-17.formula: score = 0.4×R10 + 0.3×R15 + 0.3×N10 (corrected: node-scoped cohort separation replaces edge-set replication, which was a scope mismatch)

SCAN-18.purpose: Maps QTL (eQTL/pQTL/mQTL) co-localization to pathway nodes/edges, listing the specific QTL hits.
SCAN-18.formula: qtl_hits = G03(variant_set, expression_scope); mapping = R21(qtl,pathway) × N05(gene)

SCAN-19.purpose: Compares hypothesis embeddings against anonymized cross-user hypotheses. Produces a similarity score and anonymized convergence count -- internal permission-gate primitives are no longer leaked into the output.
SCAN-19.formula: hypothesis_overlap_score = R11(h1,h2); if > threshold -> convergence signal (anonymous, count only)

SCAN-20.purpose: Reads (read-only) hypothesis state across versions: draft/active/submitted/defended/archived. Version-delta LOGGING is a post-execution write, not part of this read.
SCAN-20.formula: current_lifecycle_state = read(hypothesis.state); staleness = days_since(last_transition); convergence input from INV read, not computed here

SCAN-21.purpose: Tracks MC score (SCAN-26) over time as datasets/versions change; classifies the trajectory via a level x velocity matrix. Version increments and weight recomputation are post-execution writes, not part of this read.
SCAN-21.formula: mechanism_confidence = R06(hypothesis) [read]; mc_delta = MC_t - MC_t-1; trajectory_trend = TREND_MATRIX(MC_level, MC_velocity)

SCAN-22.purpose: Maps competitive activity density across the target landscape using cross-user signals, listing which specific targets are contested.
SCAN-22.formula: neighbors = V04(top_k=20); competitive_score = R14(node); competing_targets = TOP_K(neighbors, by=competitive_score)

SCAN-23.purpose: Identifies territory that is both under-studied (SCAN-06) and under-competed (SCAN-22), domain-scaled so 'under-studied' means something different in rare disease vs. oncology.

SCAN-24.purpose: Ranks druggable-entity targets by composite score: centrality, biomarker power, competitive landscape, mechanistic confidence, and compensatory-pathway risk.
SCAN-24.formula: TargetScore = Influence × (1−P_compensatory) × NI. Profiles: oncology_driver (add ONC_04), synthetic_lethality (add ONC_03)

SCAN-25.purpose: Predicts probable NEW edges via embedding similarity and topology. Explicitly probabilistic, never confused with SCAN-05's evidence-backed bridge_score.

SCAN-26.purpose: THE central scoring engine. Composite MC score from centrality, cohort separation, reproducibility, perturbation sensitivity, and contradiction. Also computes the companion MR (confounding-risk) score. Both are now explicitly in the output -- previously missing entirely.
SCAN-26.formula: MC = (0.25×C) + (0.25×ΔS) + (0.20×R) + (0.15×P) − (0.15×K); MR = (0.40×K) + (0.35×(1−R)) + (0.25×P_compensatory). NOTE: Hypothesis-level. Edge-level = E04 (different formula).

SCAN-27.purpose: Computes mechanistic similarity between the hypothesis indication and other SRL indications, with sanitized field names and the actual shared/divergent pathway lists.

SCAN-28.purpose: Maps off-target interaction risk for proximal targets, listing each specific off-target node and its affected biological system.
SCAN-28.formula: off_targets = propagate_signal via T12, filtered to nodes outside primary pathway; aggregate_off_target_risk = 1 − Π(1−risk_ot)

SCAN-29.purpose: Measures alignment between clinical and preclinical (animal/cell) evidence for the same mechanism, with sanitized field names.

SCAN-30.purpose: Evaluates structural stability as datasets are added -- does new data reinforce or destabilize the hypothesis. Version increments are post-execution writes, not part of this read.
SCAN-30.formula: stability_index = H02(history) = max(0, 1 − mean_|ΔMC|/0.20); version_triplet is READ (current Dv/Tv/Hv), not written here

SCAN-31.purpose: Measures convergence of evidence across datasets toward the hypothesis mechanism. The convergence-counter persistence is a post-execution write.

SCAN-32.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR (was an unformulated placeholder). Compares an edge's observed effect size against a calibrated, domain-scaled Minimum Clinically Important Difference (MCID), producing an effect adequacy score.
SCAN-32.formula: effect_adequacy_score = clip(|observed_effect_size| / mcid_threshold, 0, 1); mcid_threshold = MCID_TABLE[biological_domain][edge_class] × domain_scaling_factor

SCAN-33.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR. Stratifies edge evidence by disease stage (e.g. early vs. late, pre-symptomatic vs. clinical) and flags mechanisms whose direction or magnitude switches across stages -- an extension of SCAN-08's context stratification specialized to the temporal/staging axis.
SCAN-33.formula: stage_effect_sizes = group_by(assertions, disease_stage_tag) -> mean(ES); stage_variance = variance(stage_effect_sizes.values()); role_switch_detected = any(sign(ES_i) != sign(ES_j) for stages i,j)

SCAN-34.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR. Pure aggregation scan -- reads SCAN-10 (modality), SCAN-12 (species), SCAN-29 (clinical-preclinical), and SCAN-30 (stability) and rolls them into one weakest-link 4-axis transportability score. Does NOT recompute any underlying primitive. This is exactly the classification scheme INV-09 (Transportability Audit) already references ('per SCAN-34').
SCAN-34.formula: transportability_score = min(axis_modality, axis_species, axis_clinical, axis_stability)  [weakest-axis-drives-priority, matching INV-09's own priority basis]; classification = HIGH(>=0.65) | MODERATE(0.45-0.64) | LIMITED(0.25-0.44) | FRAGILE(<0.25)

SCAN-35.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR. Evaluates whether an edge's evidence pattern is explained by technical batch effects / platform artifacts rather than true biological signal, using ingestion metadata (batch_id, platform, lab_id).
SCAN-35.formula: artifact_risk_score = f(batch_variance, platform_variance, single_lab_dependency) = 0.4×batch_variance + 0.3×platform_variance + 0.3×(1 if single_lab_dependency else 0)

ONC-SCAN-01.purpose: Maps tumor microenvironment cell-type interaction networks as an explicit cell-type matrix, identifying immunosuppressive vs. activating TME states and the dominant checkpoint axis driving suppression.
ONC-SCAN-01.formula: tme_suppression_index = ONC_05 × (1 − IMM_01.activating_fraction); dominant_inhibitory_axis = argmax(IMM_04 checkpoint_interaction_score)

ONC-SCAN-02.purpose: Tracks clonal fraction dynamics across timepoints as an explicit array of clone objects, identifying dominant-clone emergence and forecasting resistance mechanism onset.
ONC-SCAN-02.formula: clones = ONC_02(tumor, timepoints); resistance_mechanisms = ONC_06(drug, cancer, mechanisms); dominant_clone_id = argmax(clones, key=fraction_at_latest_timepoint)

ONC-SCAN-03.purpose: Stratifies cohorts by biomarker profile, computing differential survival and evaluating companion-diagnostic (CDx) utility. Primitives now explicitly wired (source doc left this scan's primitive list unresolved).
ONC-SCAN-03.formula: biomarker_score = R10(node) [SCAN-17 profile]; tumor_mutational_burden = ONC_01(node); oncogene_addiction_score = ONC_04(node, cancer_type); cohort_stratification = survival_analysis(biomarker_positive_cohort, biomarker_negative_cohort)

IMM-SCAN-01.purpose: Scores target selectivity for immune cell subsets/tissues using an explicit tissue-expression matrix, distinguishing a locally-acting autoimmune target from one that will cause systemic immunosuppression.
IMM-SCAN-01.formula: therapeutic_window_index = 1 − (1−specificity)×(1−tolerance); tissue_expression_profile = E16(node) restricted to immune/housekeeping tissue classes; systemic_toxicity_risk = 1 − therapeutic_window_index

IMM-SCAN-02.purpose: Maps specific HLA allele associations to mechanism nodes -- the allele identity itself is now an explicit output field, not just an aggregate score.
IMM-SCAN-02.formula: hla_association_score = IMM_05(variant, hla_type); polygenic_mechanism_score = R19(...), FDR corrected (BH, alpha=0.05)

IMM-SCAN-03.purpose: Assesses cytokine cascade amplification risk from mechanism perturbation, explicitly identifying the closed feedback-loop nodes and the single best node to sever to break the cycle. RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status is mandatory in every report per safety policy.
IMM-SCAN-03.formula: cytokine_storm_risk = min((cascade/10)×(1+0.3×loops)×(downstream/20), 1); identified_feedback_loop_nodes = T07(cytokine-tagged subgraph); critical_node_to_sever = argmax(betweenness_centrality over loop nodes)

SEM-SCAN-01.purpose: Searches the SRL for functionally equivalent pathways in different domains -- lateral discovery not surfaceable by keyword/ontology search. Outputs the exact matched pathway and a reasoning_narrative, not just a similarity float.
SEM-SCAN-01.formula: pathway_equivalence_score = 0.30×SIM_01(pathway) + 0.25×SIM_05(structural) + 0.20×SIM_03(fingerprint) + 0.25×SEM_01(semantic); applicability = (1.0 if edges>=3 else 0)×(1.0 if gap_severity>0.20 else 0.50)×domain_weight(onc:1.0,imm:0.90,neuro:0.85,other:0.70)

SEM-SCAN-02.purpose: Identifies drugs on different targets whose downstream effects converge on hypothesis nodes -- repurposing/combination candidates. Names the exact bottleneck node(s) and colliding compounds.

SEM-SCAN-03.purpose: Discovers mechanistically equivalent phenotypic outcomes in non-hypothesis disease contexts, naming the specific validated endpoints.
SEM-SCAN-03.formula: phenotypic_adequacy_score = (1.0 if outcomes>=1 else 0)×(1.0 if delta_S<0.40 else 0.50)×(1.0 if context in [fundraising,pre_ind,grant] else 0.60); divergence = SIM_01(phenotype)×(1−SEM_01(mechanism))

SEM-SCAN-04.purpose: Translates mechanism signals across domains via semantic similarity of edge predicates/node roles. Broadest lateral scan, highest false-positive rate -- agent interpretation is mandatory, enforced here via a required reasoning_narrative caveat.

SEM-SCAN-05.purpose: Detects entities whose perturbation produces off-target consequences in OTHER SRL disease contexts -- lists the specific disease context and affected node, not just a risk float.

SEM-SCAN-06.purpose: Finds nodes outside the hypothesis subgraph in structurally equivalent positions (hub/bridge/bottleneck) -- backup targets, synthetic-lethal candidates. Names the specific equivalent-role node(s).

SEM-SCAN-07.purpose: Identifies resistance mechanisms via semantic translation from other contexts (oncology, infectious disease, agriculture), naming the specific cross-field mechanism being borrowed.
SEM-SCAN-07.formula: resistance_analog_score = 0.40×SIM_07(analogy) + 0.30×(1−R19(risk_divergence)) + 0.30×SEM_02(lateral); domain_resistance(onc/inf:1.0, imm:0.80, gene_therapy:0.70, rare:0.50, other:0.30)

SEM-SCAN-08.purpose: Identifies biomarkers validated elsewhere that are mechanistically translatable to the hypothesis indication.

SEM-SCAN-09.purpose: Detects scenarios where established causal direction may be INVERTED in a specific context (e.g. an activator in one tissue that is an inhibitor in another) -- distinct from simple noise/conflict. FORMULA CORRECTED THIS REFACTOR: source doc had accidentally duplicated SEM-SCAN-12's Reviewer Objection formula (SEM_04/SEM_06) onto this scan, which has nothing to do with academic review.
SEM-SCAN-09.formula: inversion_resolution = SEM_03(edge, context_groups); flagged_context_axis = argmax(variance(ES) across metadata axes)

SEM-SCAN-10.purpose: Identifies hidden context conditions (a latent modulator variable) explaining directional contradictions -- the hidden condition itself is the finding. FORMULA CORRECTED THIS REFACTOR: source doc had duplicated SEM-SCAN-13's Citation Trajectory formula (SEM_05) onto this scan, which measures publication momentum, not hidden biological modulators.
SEM-SCAN-10.formula: latent_modulator = SEM_03(edge, stratify_by=E16.modality_coverage) -> search for the metadata axis (tissue/genotype/dose/timepoint) that, when split on, resolves the contradiction

SEM-SCAN-11.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR (was an unformulated placeholder). Searches for entity-pair combinations with a non-additive combined effect -- synergy, synthetic lethality, or co-dependency.
SEM-SCAN-11.formula: synergy_score = ES(A+B combined, observed) − (ES(A alone) + ES(B alone)); combination_class = CLASSIFY(synergy_score, mechanism_context)

SEM-SCAN-12.purpose: Aggregates literature assertions and unresolved conflicts a reviewer would cite as weaknesses, across 4 dimensions (novelty/causality/reproducibility/scope), each with its own mitigation suggestion.
SEM-SCAN-12.formula: Per dimension: SEM_04(H, dimension) -- novelty: (1−NI)×(1+0.1×parallel); causality: (1−path_score)×(1+0.15×|gaps|); reproducibility: (1−R)×(1+0.2×K); scope: domain-specific. Mapping: SEM_06 -> archetypes+triggers+mitigation

SEM-SCAN-13.purpose: Detects rising vs. declining evidence momentum -- directional velocity, not just quantity. Complements SCAN-06 (Evidence Maturity). Confirmed correct owner of the SEM_05 trajectory-forecast formula.
SEM-SCAN-13.formula: trajectory_forecast = SEM_05(momentum, velocity, half_life, novelty, convergence, horizons=[6,12,24,60]); predicted[h] = base×decay×(1+novelty_premium)×convergence_boost

SEM-SCAN-14.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR; PRIVACY GATE ADDED IN THIS PASS per engineering review. Flagship network scan -- detects when two users' datasets, each individually incomplete, together close a mechanistic gap. Mechanism-level output only, no identity/content shared. A mandatory privacy gate now runs BEFORE gap_closure_events is populated: if the anonymization/k-anonymity check fails, the scan returns an e
SEM-SCAN-14.formula: privacy_gate_status = P16(anonymized_pool, min_aggregation_k=5); IF NOT privacy_gate_status.gate_passed: return gap_closure_events=[] AND HALT. ELSE: gap_closure_events = for each dormant two-hop gap (T06) in user A's graph: check if user B's anonymized graph contains the bridging edge; closure_confidence = R07(bridge) computed on the merged, anonymized edge

SEM-SCAN-15.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR. Detects absence-of-evidence and publication-bias patterns around hypothesis edges using funnel-plot-style asymmetry analysis -- an understated contradiction risk source.
SEM-SCAN-15.formula: publication_bias_score = funnel_plot_asymmetry(effect_size vs. 1/sqrt(sample_size)) [Egger's-test-style regression intercept]; estimated_missing_null_studies = trim_and_fill_estimate(observed_studies)

SEM-SCAN-16.purpose: DEFINED THIS REFACTOR. Evaluates edges for biological confounding (upstream regulators, tissue composition, immune infiltration) and classifies the third variable as CONFOUNDER / MEDIATOR / COLLIDER via a structural backdoor-path test.
SEM-SCAN-16.formula: third_variable = search(upstream_regulators(src) ∩ upstream_regulators(tgt)); backdoor_path_edges = T02(third_variable, src) + T02(third_variable, tgt); confound_classification = STRUCTURAL_TEST(third_variable, src, tgt, backdoor_path_edges)

INV-01.scope: Node (dormant candidates within the activated path's neighborhood)

INV-02.scope: Hypothesis (subgraph-wide path search between two fixed endpoints)
INV-02.purpose: Single-Route Confirmation (one validated route on a fully activated pathway)

INV-03.purpose: Conflicting Evidence (supporting and refuting citations on the same edge)

INV-04.scope: Node (dormant nodes one hop upstream of an activated cluster)
INV-04.purpose: Unexplained Convergence (activated cluster with no known common driver)

INV-05.purpose: Evidence Saturation (edge/node crosses a high-confidence threshold)
